axis: nastiness of temper → a quality that threatens evil

members.tone: Malevolence run down to nastiness — it takes in the merely nasty as readily as the truly malicious, so it can bite without carrying the threat *malice* carries.
The heaviest word here: not an unpleasant streak but a quality that holds evil over someone.
Names the cruel disposition itself, but pitched at the tension and annoyance it inflicts rather than at any graver damage.
Deliberateness is the whole of the charge — not a lapse or a bad mood but meanness meant, which is what condemns it.
